Name: Deezer
Description: Control Deezer Desktop from your Stream Deck. No runtime to install. The volume actions act on Deezer's level in the Windows mixer, which combines with the app's own volume.

com.dezzer.deezer.previous.Name: Previous track
com.dezzer.deezer.previous.Tooltip: Go back to the previous track.

com.dezzer.deezer.volume-up.Name: Volume +
com.dezzer.deezer.volume-up.Tooltip: Raise Deezer's volume in the Windows mixer. This combines with Deezer's own volume slider.

com.dezzer.deezer.volume-down.Name: Volume -
com.dezzer.deezer.volume-down.Tooltip: Lower Deezer's volume in the Windows mixer. This combines with Deezer's own volume slider.

com.dezzer.deezer.now-playing.Name: Now playing
com.dezzer.deezer.now-playing.Tooltip: Show the artwork, title, artist and progress. Press to play or pause.

com.dezzer.deezer.diagnostics.Name: Deezer status
com.dezzer.deezer.diagnostics.Tooltip: Show the status of the local service and of Deezer. Press to restart the service.

diagnostic.bridgeStopped: The local service is stopped. Press to restart it.
diagnostic.bridgeFailed: The local component could not start.
diagnostic.deezerOff: Open Deezer Desktop, then play a track.

pi.volumeHint: The Volume actions act on Deezer's slider in the Windows mixer, not inside Deezer. Both levels combine: 50 % on each side gives 25 % of the sound.
pi.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the token? The local service restarts immediately.
pi.diagnosticHint: Contains no token. Paste it as-is into a bug report.
